cues.text: Ask AI about your documents.
Get summaries and answers that cite the exact page they came from.
Open Ask AI.
Open a document and click Ask AI at the top.
The panel opens beside the page.
Summarize.
Click Summarize with key facts, or one of the suggested questions that fit your document.
Follow the citations.
Answers show page references.
Click one to jump to that page, with the quoted words highlighted.
Ask across your library.
Switch to Whole library to ask about all your documents at once, for example which contracts renew soon.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Automations.
Let pdftek do routine work: flag risks on upload, send a morning digest, remind you of renewals.
Open Automations.
Click Automations in the left menu on Home, or the Automate tab in Ask AI.
Start from a recipe.
Pick Risk review on upload, Morning digest, Renewal reminders or Signed → tracker, or build your own.
When and then.
Choose when it runs (a document is uploaded, a signature completes, a renewal is coming, or a schedule) and what happens next (extract, tag, notify or email).
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
What your clients see.
Your clients sign in to your portal to upload documents, see what's needed and message you.
Passwordless sign-in.
Clients enter their email and type the code you send them, or click the one-time link in their invite.
Upload from any device.
Their checklist shows what's still needed.
They can upload from a phone camera or computer, and mark items that don't apply.
Messages and shared files.
Clients message you securely and download files you share with them.
Use Open client portal in Clients to see it as they do.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Request documents from clients.
Send checklists, track progress by stage, and let AI check every upload.
Request documents.
Open a client and click Request documents.
Start from New client onboarding, ID verification, Employee onboarding, a tax checklist or your own list.
Repeat automatically.
Choose to repeat the request every month, quarter or year, for example for monthly bookkeeping.
Uploads are checked.
Each upload is checked against the item it was sent for, renamed and filed under the client and year.
Problems are flagged for you and for the client.
Move clients along.
Click a stage to move the client from Waiting on client through to Completed.
The dashboard shows who needs attention.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Set up Clients and your portal.
Give your clients a branded portal and keep everything about each client in one place.
Open Clients.
Click Clients in the left menu.
The dashboard shows where every client stands for the fiscal year.
Brand your portal.
In Firm settings, set your firm's name, colour and logo.
Clients see them when they sign in.
Add clients.
Click Add client, or Import to bring in a spreadsheet of names and emails.
Pro includes up to 50 active clients.
Invite them.
Open a client and click Invite to portal.
They sign in with a code by email, with no password to remember.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Cloud storage, email in and Stripe.
Connect Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive, email documents to pdftek, and get paid with Stripe.
Open Integrations.
Open Settings, Integrations.
Cloud storage.
Connect Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive to open files from them and save results back with Save to cloud.
Email to pdftek.
Turn on your workspace's email address.
Attachments sent to it are added to your documents, and you choose who can send.
Payments with Stripe.
Connect Stripe to collect payments when people sign.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Compare two documents.
See every change between two documents, or between two versions of one.
Open Compare.
Click Compare under Organize in All tools, or Compare in your account menu.
Pick the two documents.
Choose the original and the new one.
Additions and deletions are highlighted side by side.
Compare versions.
In Version history, click Compare next to an earlier version to see what changed.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Compress a PDF.
Make a large PDF smaller so it is easier to email and upload.
Open Compress.
Open the document and click Compress under Organize in All tools.
Create the smaller copy.
Choose Recommended for good quality at a much smaller size, or a stronger setting, and create the smaller copy.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Convert a PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint or images.
Turn a PDF into an editable Office file or into images, keeping the layout.
Open the PDF.
Open the document from Home, or click Convert on Home and choose your file.
Pick a format.
In All tools, under Convert, click To Word, To Excel, To PowerPoint, To JPG or To PNG.
More formats.
Click More formats for WEBP, TIFF or plain text, or to convert only the page you are looking at.
Download.
The converted file downloads straight away.
Your original PDF stays in your documents.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint or images to PDF.
Make a PDF from Office files, text files, TIFFs or a set of photos.
Files to PDF.
In All tools, click Files → PDF, or choose Word, Excel or PowerPoint to PDF in the New menu.
Add your files.
Pick one or more files.
Each becomes a PDF in your documents, ready for every other tool.
Images to PDF.
Choose Images to PDF to combine photos into one document.
Set the page size and the order before you create it.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Request documents with a secure link.
Send a checklist and collect files without email attachments.
Anyone can upload, no account needed.
New request.
Click Requests in the left menu, then New request.
Start from a checklist such as ID verification or Rental application, or write your own.
Send it.
Add the person's email and a due date.
They get a secure link; reminders go out automatically until everything arrives.
Collect the files.
Uploads land in your documents, named and tagged.
You can see what's still missing at a glance.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Edit text and images in a PDF.
Change existing text, type anywhere, add images, highlight, draw and white out.
Start editing.
Open the document and click Edit PDF on Home or in All tools.
You hold the edit lock while you work, so teammates don't overwrite you.
Change or add text.
Click any text to change it in a matching font, or choose Add text and click where you want to type.
Images, highlights and drawings.
Use Image, Highlight, Draw, Shape and Whiteout in the toolbar above the page.
Colour and thickness appear when a tool is selected.
Save a new version.
Click Save version.
Your edit becomes a new version, and the earlier one stays in Version history.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Extract key terms, dates and tables.
Pull structured data out of a document into a table you can download.
Open Extract.
Click Ask AI, then the Extract tab, or Extract data under AI in All tools.
Choose what to pull.
Pick Key terms, Dates and deadlines, Risk flags, Obligations, Parties, Financial figures or Tables.
Use the results.
Results appear as tables with page references.
Download them as a spreadsheet.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Fill a PDF form with AI.
pdftek finds every field and fills it from your profile.
You check and finish the rest.
Open Fill form.
Open the form and click Fill a form on Home or Fill form in All tools.
Review the fields.
Every field is found, including on scanned forms, and filled from your saved profile.
Click any field to change it.
Sign and save.
Add your signature, then save the filled form as a new version or download it.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Get started with pdftek.
A quick tour of your workbench: the Home screen, your documents and where every tool lives.
Start free.
Click Start free on pdftek.com.
You get a private workspace straight away, no sign-up needed.
Create a free account to keep your files and get more tasks a day.
Your Home screen.
Home shows a greeting, six quick starts (Convert, Edit PDF, Sign or send, Fill a form, Scan and Ask AI) and your recent documents.
The left menu.
Use the menu on the left for Documents, Clients, Signatures, Requests, Automations, All tools and Trash.
Your plan and AI credits are at the bottom.
Open a document.
Click any document to open it.
The page sits in the middle, every tool is listed on the left and Ask AI opens on the right.
Go back Home.
Click the arrow at the top left of a document to return to Home at any time.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Language, dark mode and your profile.
Use pdftek in 26 languages, switch to dark mode and keep your profile up to date.
Account menu.
Click your initials at the top right for Profile, Plan & billing, the language, Dark mode, feedback and Sign out.
Change the language.
Click the language name and pick from 26 languages.
The whole site and app switch.
Dark mode.
Choose Dark mode for a darker workbench; choose Light mode to switch back.
Your profile.
In Settings, Profile, update your name and password.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Merge and split PDFs.
Combine documents into one, or break one into parts by page ranges.
Merge.
Click Merge in All tools or in the New menu.
Pick the documents, drag them into order and create the merged PDF.
Split.
Open a document and click Split.
Type page ranges such as 1-3, 4-6 and each range becomes its own PDF.
Extract pages.
Click Extract pages to copy just the pages you need into a new document.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Make a scan searchable (OCR).
Recognize the text in scanned pages so you can search, copy and listen to it.
Spot a scan.
Scanned documents show a Scan badge on Home, and a notice above the page when you open them.
Run OCR.
Click Run OCR on the notice, or OCR in All tools.
Pick every language in the document and click Start OCR.
Search the text.
Text recognition runs privately in your browser.
Afterwards the document's words appear in search and Read aloud.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Reorder, rotate and delete pages.
Rearrange pages visually and save the result as a new version.
Open Organize pages.
Open the document and click Organize pages under Organize in All tools.
Drag, rotate or remove.
Drag thumbnails to reorder them, rotate pages that are sideways and remove the ones you don't need.
Use the page thumbnails.
The thumbnails beside the page show every page.
Click one to jump to it; the control at the bottom zooms and fits the page to the width.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Use pdftek on your phone.
Everything works on a phone: scan with the camera, open tools from a sheet and ask the AI full screen.
Home on your phone.
Search sits at the top, with six quick starts and your recent documents below.
The bar at the bottom has Home, Files, Scan, Clients and Account.
Scan.
Tap the big Scan button to photograph paper documents. pdftek finds the edges, straightens the page and saves a clean PDF.
Tools for the open document.
Open a document and tap Tools.
The sheet shows the most used tools; tap All tools for everything.
Ask AI.
Tap Ask AI for answers about the document.
Tap a page reference in an answer to jump straight to that page.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Plans, Day Pass and AI credits.
Free tools stay free.
Upgrade for editing, e-signatures, Clients and more AI.
See your plan.
Your plan and AI credits are at the bottom of the left menu and in your account menu.
Upgrade or top up.
Open Settings, Plan & billing to start a free Pro trial, buy a Day Pass for 24 hours, or top up AI credits.
Manage billing.
Change or cancel your plan and download invoices from the same page.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Your review playbook.
Tell the AI your team's rules so it flags what matters to you.
Write your rules.
Open Settings, Review playbook, and write your positions, for example: liability cap at least 12 months of fees, no auto-renewal over one year.
Check documents against it.
Risk flags in Extract, and Compare to playbook in Ask AI, check each document against these rules.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Add or remove a password.
Encrypt a PDF with a password and permissions, or unlock one you can open.
Add a password.
Click Add password under Protect in All tools.
Set a password, and choose whether people may print, copy or edit.
Remove a password.
Click Remove password, upload the locked PDF and enter its password.
An unlocked copy is added to your documents.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Listen to a document.
Have pdftek read a document to you, in 11 languages.
Start reading.
Open the document and click Read PDF under AI in All tools.
Control playback.
Pause, skip, change the speed or the voice.
Reading starts from the page you are on.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Redact sensitive information.
Permanently remove names, numbers or anything else before you share a document.
Open Redact.
Click Redact under Edit or Protect in All tools.
Mark what to remove.
Drag over text or areas to black them out.
Each mark can be moved or deleted until you save.
Save.
Click Save version.
Redacted content is removed from the file for good, not just hidden.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Request signatures.
Send a document for legally binding e-signature, with reminders and an audit trail.
Click Request signature.
Open the document and click Request signature at the top.
Add signers and fields.
Add each signer's name and email, then drag signature, date, initials and text fields onto the page for each person.
Choose whether they sign in order.
Send and track.
Click Send.
Signers get an email with a secure link.
Follow progress, send reminders or cancel in Signatures.
The signed copy.
When everyone has signed, the signed PDF and its audit trail are saved as a new version and emailed to everyone.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Scan paper documents.
Use your phone or laptop camera to make a clean, straight, searchable PDF.
Open the scanner.
Click Scan on Home, choose Scan with camera in the New menu, or tap the Scan button on your phone.
Capture pages.
Hold the page in view and take a photo. pdftek detects the edges and straightens it; add as many pages as you need.
Save and make it searchable.
Save the scan as a PDF.
Run OCR on it so you can search and copy its text.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Search everything.
One search box finds documents by name, words inside any page, tools, or sends your question to the AI.
Open search.
Click the search box at the top, or press the slash key on your keyboard from anywhere.
Find a tool, a document or a page.
Type a few letters.
Results show matching tools, document names and the exact pages where your words appear, highlighted.
Jump to the page.
Click a result inside a document and it opens at that page with your words highlighted.
Ask instead.
The last result asks the AI your question, about the open document or your whole library.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Signing templates, bulk send, signing links and payments.
Set a document up once and send it forever, to many people at once or with one public link.
Save a template.
Click Save as template under Fill & sign.
Name the roles, for example Client, and place their fields once.
Bulk send.
In Signatures, choose a template and Bulk send.
Paste a list of names and emails; everyone gets their own copy.
One link anyone can sign.
Create a Signing link to put on your website or in an email.
Set an end date or a limit on signers if you need to.
Get paid when they sign.
Connect Stripe in Settings, Integrations, then add Collect a payment to a template or link.
Signers pay as they sign.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Bank statements and invoices to Excel.
Pull every transaction or line item into a clean spreadsheet, checked against the totals.
Choose the converter.
Click Statement → Excel or Invoice → Excel under Convert in All tools.
Check the results.
Transactions are listed with dates, descriptions and amounts and checked against the opening and closing balances.
Download.
Download the spreadsheet, ready for your accounting software.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Translate a PDF.
Translate a whole PDF into 35+ languages while keeping its layout.
Open Translate.
Click Translate under AI in All tools.
Pick the language.
Choose the language.
You see roughly how many credits it will use before you start.
Open the translation.
The translated PDF is added to your documents and opens when it is ready.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Upload and organize documents.
Add files from your computer, your phone or the cloud, then rename, tag, filter and tidy them up.
Add files.
Click New, then Upload files, or drag files anywhere onto the Home screen.
PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images and TIFF all work; other formats become PDFs as they upload.
From the cloud.
Choose From Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive in the New menu to open files straight from your cloud storage.
Filter and switch views.
Use the chips to show only PDFs, files from Office, scans or a tag.
Switch between the grid and the list with the buttons on the right.
Rename, tag or download.
Click the three dots on a document for Rename, Tags, Download PDF or Move to trash.
Tags appear as filter chips so you can group documents.
Restore from Trash.
Deleted something by mistake?
Click Trash in the left menu and choose Restore.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Versions, check out and hand off.
Every change is a version you can restore.
Lock a document while you work or pass it to a teammate.
Version history.
Click the three dots at the top right of a document, then Version history.
View, compare or restore any earlier version.
Check out.
Choose Check out to lock editing while you work.
Teammates can still read and ask the AI; click Check in when you're done.
Hand off.
Choose Hand off to a teammate, pick a person and add a note.
They're notified, and your lock moves with it.
Share a link.
Click the share button to copy a link to the document for people in your workspace.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Watermarks, page numbers and properties.
Stamp DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL, number your pages or set the title and author.
Watermark.
Click Watermark under Edit in All tools, type the text, then choose its size, angle and opacity.
Page numbers.
Click Page numbers to add Page 1 of 10, plain numbers or Bates numbers in the corner you choose.
Properties.
Click Properties to set the document's title, author and subject.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
Workspaces and teammates.
Keep work separate in workspaces and invite your team with the right permissions.
Switch or add workspaces.
Click the workspace name at the top to switch, or choose New workspace.
Each has its own documents, members and billing.
Invite teammates.
Open Settings, Members.
Enter an email and choose a role: Member or Admin.
The person who created the workspace is its Owner.
What roles can do.
Admins invite people, edit the playbook and release edit locks.
Owners also manage billing.
That’s it.
Find every guide and video in the pdftek Help Center.
